༄༅/ /klu bsang bsdus pa bzhugs/klu bsang bya ba la klu rdzas klu sman klu shing sna tshogs pa bsregs la/oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: klu bsang bya ba la klu rdzas klu sman klu shing sna tshogs pa bsregs la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du bsang rdzas zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis rlabs la 'di skad do/ / kyai dbus kyi dbus rgyal chu lha ni/ /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs kas mdzes/ /phyag gnyis thal sbyar 'dzum bag can/ /lha lus rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba ni/ /de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa 'bul/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa 'bul/ / klu rdzas sna tshogs= /mchod pa 'bul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /klu yi g.yang dang dngos grub nas/ /mi dang nor 'phel bkra shis dang*/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /nad med dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /kyai shar du mtha' yas lho ru padma dang*/ /nub tu 'jogs po byang du nor rgyas dang*/ /shar lhor dung skyong lho nub karko ṭa/ /nub byang rigs ldan byang shar padma rnams/ /de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa 'bul/ /kyai rje rigs dang ni bram ze'i rigs/ /dmangs rigs gdol ba'i rigs rnams dang*/ khyad par yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ /klu gnyan sa bdag 'khor bcas dang*/ /gnyan gtor klu dang sde brgyad sogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bsang*/ / gnas dang pho brang bshig pa dang*/ /'khor dang longs spyod brlag pa dang*/ /sa gnyan rdo gnyan shing gnyan dang*/ /chu gnyan chu mig bsrubs pa dang*/ /mi gtsang dri mas phog pa sogs/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyis khyed rnams la/ /nad dang gnod pa ci mchis pa/ /mchod pa'i rdzas kyi gsos gyur cig /bdud rtsi bsang gis dag gyur cig

/dag pa'i dang du gnas gyur cig /dga' bde'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag dang yon bdag la/ /klu yis g.yang dang dngos grub nas/ /mi dang nor 'phel bkra shis dang*/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /nad med dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /klu gnyan sa bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /nad dang gdug rtsub ma btang zhig /mi la na tsha ma btang zhig /nor la god kha ma btang zhig /zhing las sad ser ma btang zhig /rnal 'byor bdag dang yon bdag la/ /rig 'dzin tshe dang stobs ldan mthu/ /dbang thang bu dang mdzod ldan nor/ /grags pa snyan dang kha dog gos/ /rkang 'gro nor dang skyid spyod zas/ /da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / klu bsang nye bar bsdus pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 34 -- PAGE 33 -- PAGE 33 -
